tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Brand color, LINEN #F1EFE7. The page ground in light layouts; text on black and peacock blue.

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: Brand color, SKY BLUE #4D9EC0. Large fills, photo mats, graphic blocks, and links/accents on black. Fails as text on linen (2.6:1) — never set body copy in it on light grounds.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand color, BLACK #101010. Primary ink on linen; the ground of the dark theme.

tokens.name: peacock-blue
tokens.usage: Brand color, PEACOCK BLUE #016795. The signature accent: rules, buttons, links and headings on linen (5.4:1). On black it is 3.1:1, so use it there only for type 24px+ and graphics.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and form fields that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta lines, side labels on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active states, emphasized words and button fills on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 1px frame and section rules that divide a page, as in the brand book grid.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers and field borders where a peacock rule would be too loud (decorative; not for meaning).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, offset 2px. 5.4:1 on linen, 6.3:1 on black.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines and covers. Lowercase, tight, League Spartan Bold — the voice of the wordmarks.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and sub-section titles; sentence case allowed.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Side-rail labels, eyebrows and titles like FOUNDER, CEO. Set in UPPERCASE; widely tracked.

styles.name: tracked
styles.usage: The wide-tracked lowercase sub-line under a wordmark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets; gap between a label and its rule.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, icon-to-text, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; padding inside small blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gutter between photos.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margins and the width of the side label rail (brand-book frame).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for every block, photo, button and panel. The family is square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields and small chips only, to soften a hard pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, discs and the oval badge shape. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Section rules and frames, as in the brand book's grid.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focus rings and emphasized rules.
